fact: AfricaNenda's SIIPS 2024 says Djibouti has integrated to PAPSS, though it is unclear whether any retail transactions are processed.
PAPSS lists Djibouti as a country with live send-and-receive participants: East African Bank and Salaam African Bank.
The Banque Centrale de Djibouti's 2024 annual report says no institution may carry on financial activity without its licence, and names D-Money and WAAFI as the two e-money issuers it supervises.

The Banque Centrale de Djibouti's 2024 annual report says its automated clearing house, part of the SYRAD system it runs since 2022, cleared 26,970 low-value transfers and 28,683 cheques for 13 participants in 2024.
